Class ImplCardBD

java.lang.Object
com.dami.tcg.modelo.ImplCardBD
All Implemented Interfaces:
CardDAO
public class ImplCardBD extends Object implements CardDAO
JDBC-based implementation of the CardDAO interface.

Provides concrete database operations for Card entities using direct JDBC connections. Database connection parameters are loaded from the configDB.properties resource bundle.

Author:
Brayan, Adam, Oihan and Asier

    • queryRandomCard

      public Card queryRandomCard()
      Retrieves a random card from the database based on rarity probabilities.

      Selects a random card from the database based on rarity probabilities:

      • Mythic: 1% chance
      • Legendary: 4% chance
      • Epic: 10% chance
      • Rare: 25% chance
      • Common: 60% chance

      Specified by:
      queryRandomCard in interface CardDAO
      Returns:
      a randomly selected Card

    • queryShopCards

      public ArrayList<Card> queryShopCards(int playerId)
      Retrieves the list of cards available in the shop for a given player.

      If playerId is 0, returns a default set of random cards.

      If playerId is 0, returns 3 random cards as a default shop display for unauthenticated users. Otherwise, queries the ShopCards table for the player's assigned shop cards.

      Specified by:
      queryShopCards in interface CardDAO
      Parameters:
      playerId - the ID of the player (0 for default/unauthenticated)
      Returns:
      an ArrayList of Card objects available in the shop
